rules.text: In single-cell widget info XMLs, declare android:resizeMode="none" and android:widgetFeatures="reconfigurable"; never set resize modes or add configuration_optional. Enforce all widget metadata contracts, ampersand escaping, and 2-line wrapping through automated JVM tests (WidgetContractInvariantsTest.kt).
Strip androidx.startup.InitializationProvider via tools:node="remove" in AndroidManifest.xml.
Store stable serialization codes or specify -keepclassmembers,allowoptimization enum * { <fields>; } in proguard-rules.pro.

Wrap all persistence mutations in synchronized(globalStoreLock). Write disk backups via temporary file replacement (Files.move with REPLACE_EXISTING), and quarantine unparseable payloads in items_v1_quarantine rather than overwriting valid backups.
Invoke purgeWidgetBindingsForItem(itemId) across all configurable widget families inside CountUpStore.deleteItem().

Verify serialized RemoteViews parcels stay strictly under 40KB via WidgetMemoryBudgetGateTest. Clamp procedural bitmaps using computeSafeDimensions or computeSafeSize (W x H x 4 <= 24 KB for 1x1, <= 32 KB for 2x2) and adopt the 1:1.18 tall seal aspect ratio on vertical launcher grids.

Always reuse canonical ItemCard across all widget configure screens with no-op handlers. Standardize haptics to TextHandleMove, use explicit size(26.dp) or size(30.dp) on compact action clusters, and apply clipping exclusively to outer card containers.
Maintain <queries> for RecognitionService and RECOGNIZE_SPEECH and delegate audio capture out-of-process via RecognizerIntent.
Validate appWidgetId != INVALID_APPWIDGET_ID, verify caller identity against package ownership, and return results containing only EXTRA_APPWIDGET_ID.

Compute next midnight using now.toLocalDate().plusDays(1).atStartOfDay(now.zone).plusSeconds(1).toInstant().toEpochMilli(). Re-register via RTC_WAKEUP in widget onUpdate() / onEnabled(), and listen for ACTION_MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED in the manifest to restore rollover alarms across app updates.

Never run an aggressive orphaned-binding purge on app startup. Implement onRestored(oldIds, newIds) on all AppWidgetProvider classes delegating to CountUpStore.remapWidgetBindings, and restrict deletion to onDeleted() or deleteItem().

Use FileOutputStream.fd.sync() paired with java.nio.file.Files.move(tempPath, targetPath, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING) for robust atomic file snapshots across both Android and desktop unit test environments.
In centered responsive layouts, apply .widthIn(max = 640.dp) before .fillMaxWidth().fillMaxHeight().

When using android:previewLayout, always populate layout XMLs with default localized @string/... text and static preview tracks across all 7 locale files. Whenever adjusting typography baselines, dash widths, or letter spacing in live widget layouts, immediately synchronize the corresponding android:previewImage vector drawable.

Never call window.setStatusBarColor() or window.setNavigationBarColor(). Set layoutInDisplayCutoutMode = LAYOUT_IN_DISPLAY_CUTOUT_MODE_ALWAYS on API 28+, isNavigationBarContrastEnforced = false on API 29+, and manage icon contrast via WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, view).isAppearanceLightStatusBars.

Always set a unique data URI (intent.data = Uri.parse("countup://widget/overview/$appWidgetId")) on any service intent passed to views.setRemoteAdapter() when multiple widget instances display instance-specific collections.

In all RemoteViewsFactory implementations, always use defensive bounds checking (rows.getOrNull(position) ?: return RemoteViews(...) and rows.getOrNull(position)?.id?.hashCode()?.toLong() ?: position.toLong()) instead of raw array indexing.

Default modal option toggles to calm OFF (在微件中隐藏 = false) for exclusion or suppression overrides. Mirror the active override state with subtle, subdued micro-symbols (ic_widget_off, 11dp, 50-55% alpha) on compact card surfaces beside status pins.

In circular glanceable widgets, unify the visual path into a single generous orbit track (8dp-proportional gauge) with the cadence milestone nestled directly on the track. Strip container backgrounds and borders from secondary milestone labels, rendering them as quiet, unboxed whispers without negative deficit math.

In compact RemoteViews (1x1 and 2x2), replace fixed heights with proportional layout_weight (layout_weight="1.2" moon disc, layout_weight="1.0" pedestal). Bound numeral auto-sizing (12-24sp on 1x1, 14-30sp on 2x2), configure 2-line auto-sizing tags (maxLines="2", autoSizeTextType="uniform", 6.5-9sp), and dynamically hide decorative hairline dashes in the receiver when tags wrap or exceed 10 chars.

risk_areas.why: Build configuration, dependency updates, and packaging options.
Core Compose UI rendering, touch targets, and card interactions.
Persistence, JSON backup decoding, and widget binding lifecycle.
RemoteViews broadcast receiver, intent wiring, and theme dispatch.
Single-cell widget launcher placement and auto-launch configure contracts.
Component export security, zero-permission manifest, and startup stripper.

checklist.text: Run ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest to verify all existing unit and contract tests pass.
Confirm the tree is clean: git status --porcelain.
Read docs/RECURRING_ISSUES.md before touching any widget provider or XML layout.
Maintain zero runtime permissions; never add RECORD_AUDIO or RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED to AndroidManifest.xml.
Preserve android:resizeMode="none" and reconfigurable in zen_pebble_widget_info.xml; never add configuration_optional.
Ensure all widget info XMLs declare both previewImage and previewLayout with populated localized @string/... default text.
Set unique data URIs (intent.data = Uri.parse(...)) on collection service intents to avoid RemoteViews adapter factory cache collisions.
Omit Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize() from 26dp subheader and 30dp card action button clusters.
Wrap all CountUpStore mutations in synchronized(globalStoreLock) and invoke purgeWidgetBindingsForItem(itemId) on deletion.
In compact RemoteViews, use weighted layout heights and auto-sizing 2-line tags to prevent OEM cell clipping.
Run ./gradlew assembleRelease to confirm R8 rules preserve all data models, enums, and widget providers.
Verify widget RemoteViews payload remains below 40KB via WidgetMemoryBudgetGateTest.
